findings.details: Startup shows localized readiness while identity is checked, distinguishes storage faults from auth/expiry and configuration states, and exposes a read-context Retry action for missing, denied, and failed IndexedDB opens. Retrying a transient open failure preserves the existing account, session, and persisted mock client ID.
No duplicate CSS was added. Sign-in primary and password-toggle measurements satisfy shared desktop minima of 40/32 px at widths 1440 and 768, and phone minima of 48/48 px at widths 390 and 767.

qa68_consumer_integration.details: Bootstrap uses serviceRecoveryAction with read context and serviceProblemMessage with read context. App.refreshIdentity forwards result.error.retry exactly and omits retry when absent. RuntimeFailure uses the shared Notice primitive because the app LocaleProvider is unavailable during bootstrap failure.
